comments.author: @HiddenCanada
comments.text:
Crawford Lake can preserve traces of Indigenous farming, industrial pollution, and even nuclear fallout almost year by year.

The big question is: if you had to choose one moment when the “age of humans” truly began, what would you pick, early farming, the Industrial Revolution, or the nuclear age?

And if you’ve ever visited Crawford Lake, let me know what it was like.

👍 If you enjoyed this rabbit hole, please like the video and subscribe, it really helps the channel.
